Importing numpy.f2py may require a built numpy in the working tree; if the checkout is not built, the import will fail on both revisions and the transition will not be observed. The evidence does not state a build requirement, so this is an assumption to verify.

The second command in test_commands (numpy.test()) is a broad suite and is not the selected test; it is not used here.
